The Trellix Advanced Research Center has uncovered an active malware campaign that exploits a DLL sideloading vulnerability within the legitimate ahost.exe utility.
Attackers achieve evasion by pairing a malicious libcares-2.dll with any signed version of the legitimate ahost.exe (which they often rename) to execute their code.
The key vulnerability is that the design of ahost.exe is vulnerable to DLL side-loading or search order hijacking.
An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by placing a malicious DLL, named libcares-2.dll, in the same directory as ahost.exe, thereby gaining unauthorized access.
